# Trunk reachability proves inclusion even when the forge reports a closed PR.
# No closed-change prompt is needed, and surviving upstacks retain the history.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-10-31T18:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add feat1.txt
gs bc -m 'Add feature 1' feat1
git add feat2.txt
gs bc -m 'Add feature 2' feat2
gs ss --fill

# Close the lower PR, then land its commits directly on trunk.
shamhub reject alice/example 1
git push origin feat1:main
gs trunk

# An empty robot script rejects unexpected prompts.
env ROBOT_INPUT=$WORK/golden/no-prompts.txt ROBOT_OUTPUT=$WORK/prompts.actual
gs repo sync
stderr 'feat1: #1 was merged'
! stderr 'closed but not merged'
cmp $WORK/prompts.actual $WORK/golden/no-prompts.txt
! git rev-parse --verify feat1

# The open upstack is not reachable from trunk and must remain tracked.
gs bco feat2
gs sr
gs ss --fill
shamhub dump comments
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/comments.txt

-- repo/feat1.txt --
feature 1
-- repo/feat2.txt --
feature 2
-- golden/no-prompts.txt --
-- golden/comments.txt --
- change: 1
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #1 ◀
        - #2

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
- change: 2
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #1
        - #2 ◀

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
